scope: Confirmed findings from the tested research workflows; this is not a proof of exhaustive correctness for arbitrary corpora or every browser.

release.status: Validated locally; see the associated pull request and user audit report for final deployment verification.

findings.finding: One global language for a mixed collection
findings.resolution: Per-document language overrides and explicit tags in the ten-language teaching corpus.
findings.verification: Ten-language matrix, mixed collection and Turkish override tests.

findings.finding: Documents could only be inspected
findings.resolution: Add/edit/rename/remove documents, assign languages, append files and undo changes. Appending preserves the corpus name.
findings.verification: Browser edit/add/remove/undo/append tests.

findings.finding: Document statistics repeatedly scanned all tokens
findings.resolution: Accumulate document token/type/hapax counts in one pass.
findings.verification: 100-document and 2M-character tests; exact aggregate totals.

findings.finding: UTF-16 context slicing could cut emoji or combining sequences
findings.resolution: Context uses grapheme boundaries; original UTF-16 match offsets remain intact.
findings.verification: Emoji ZWJ, combining marks and exact-offset tests.

findings.finding: Concordance lacked adjustable context, document selection and sorting
findings.resolution: 20–500 grapheme context, document filter, nearest-word left sorting, right sorting and document sorting.
findings.verification: Browser Chinese-only search and sorting controls; lexical-order regression test.

findings.finding: Multiword collocation queries silently returned no results
findings.resolution: A clear query-specific error requests one segmented node word; valid input clears the error.
findings.verification: Ten-language invalid-phrase tests and browser correction check.

findings.finding: Core context/window/count parameters accepted invalid values
findings.resolution: Validate context, token-window and positive minimum-count boundaries.
findings.verification: Engine negative-context and parameter validation checks.

findings.finding: Table search used generic case folding and unnormalized query text
findings.resolution: NFC-aware filters respect document and bilingual language tags, including Turkish I.
findings.verification: Turkish, French NFC and Arabic filter regression tests.

findings.finding: Older async failures and results could mislead the current view
findings.resolution: Version guards, reset query errors, explicit comparison errors, and cleared stale analysis while recomputing.
findings.verification: Browser rapid workflow changes; code review and production build.

findings.finding: Saving omitted case and stop-list settings
findings.resolution: Save and restore complete options and per-document languages; export version 3 backups and accept version 2.
findings.verification: IndexedDB and JSON round trips; browser changed-settings restore.

findings.finding: Malformed/null backup documents could crash restoration
findings.resolution: Deep validation of documents, locales, options, sizes and document counts; failed imports leave the current corpus available.
findings.verification: Malformed, null, empty, oversized and invalid-locale backup tests.

findings.finding: Every Save created a new record; rapid clicks could race
findings.resolution: Update the active record, serialize overlapping saves and guard against assigning a saved ID to a different active corpus.
findings.verification: Exclusive-save regression tests and browser double-click retest: one saved copy.

findings.finding: Library removal had no review step
findings.resolution: Review dialog with backup export and cancellation before removing the saved copy.
findings.verification: Browser cancellation and focus tests; storage deletion tested in an isolated test database.

findings.finding: Import/review dialogs did not confine keyboard focus
findings.resolution: Move focus into dialogs, make background inert, trap Tab, support Escape and restore focus.
findings.verification: Automated keyboard/focus test and browser TMX Escape cancellation.

findings.finding: The first two variants were used regardless of language
findings.resolution: Parse canonical language tags and choose the source/target pair; a corpus import creates one document per language.
findings.verification: Reordered/missing variants and ten-language TMX tests; browser en/fr selection.

findings.finding: Malformed, untagged or duplicate variants could be ambiguous
findings.resolution: Reject invalid XML, absent tags/segments and duplicate same-language variants.
findings.verification: Malformed/ambiguous TMX regression cases.

findings.finding: Inline formatting codes could become corpus words
findings.resolution: Remove formatting-code payloads while preserving readable segment text.
findings.verification: TMX bpt/ept/hi regression fixture.

findings.finding: TMX exports and table imports lost research notes
findings.resolution: Round-trip a Corpuscape TMX note property and choose an optional note column for table imports.
findings.verification: All ten-language TMX note round trips, CSV annotation import and actual downloaded TMX validation.

findings.finding: Invalid or duplicate export tags and XML controls were not rejected
findings.resolution: Require two distinct explicit BCP 47 tags and XML-compatible text.
findings.verification: Invalid, duplicate, undetermined and XML-control tests.

findings.finding: Cancelling language selection could change existing pair metadata
findings.resolution: Keep pending TMX language choices separate until import succeeds.
findings.verification: Browser cancel retained en/ja tags, then en/fr import succeeded.

findings.finding: WebVTT comments/styles/regions and cue identifiers leaked into text
findings.resolution: Parse cue blocks and retain only decoded cue payloads; numeric cue text is preserved.
findings.verification: SRT/VTT file fixtures and NOTE/STYLE/REGION/identifier tests.

findings.finding: Non-UTF-8 text could be silently replaced with corrupt characters
findings.resolution: Strict UTF-8 decoding, BOM-marked UTF-16 support, and actionable conversion errors.
findings.verification: UTF-8, UTF-16 LE/BE and invalid-byte tests.

findings.finding: Structured imports had inconsistent character-limit checks
findings.resolution: Enforce extracted table and raw-text limits before committing the import.
findings.verification: Oversized text/table/backup tests and real capacity import.

findings.finding: Only the first worksheet was accessible
findings.resolution: Select a worksheet and then explicitly choose header and text/source/target/note columns.
findings.verification: Real two-sheet workbook test and browser second-sheet/header/column selection.

findings.finding: A failed PDF load could skip worker cleanup
findings.resolution: Destroy the PDF loading task in finally, including failed loads.
findings.verification: Production build; selectable-text PDF import; corrupt/empty-text error paths preserve the active corpus; cleanup reviewed.

findings.finding: Invalid rows were silently removed and blank numbers became zero
findings.resolution: Strict CSV/TSV parsing, optional explicit header, row-level errors and export blocking until corrected.
findings.verification: Malformed/blank/negative/nonfinite figures and browser invalid-input check.

findings.finding: An empty/invalid figure displayed teaching values
findings.resolution: Show an honest empty/error state; examples load only through an explicit button.
findings.verification: Empty-chart regression and browser zero-SVG/disabled-export assertion.

findings.finding: Long labels and titles were silently truncated
findings.resolution: Wrap full Unicode labels/titles, retain full values in SVG descriptions/tooltips, and handle RTL labels.
findings.verification: All three SVG styles with ten scripts, long labels and visual PNG inspection.

findings.finding: Figures lacked normalized corpus units and ordering
findings.resolution: Raw counts or per-million values, source/value/label ordering and explicit item counts.
findings.verification: Browser units/order/limit checks and ten-language value tests.

findings.finding: Chart values lacked readable axes and an accessible data view
findings.resolution: Zero-baseline grid/ticks, explicit units, complete label/value table and unrounded CSV.
findings.verification: SVG geometry tests, browser value-table check and actual CSV validation.

findings.finding: There was no raster export
findings.resolution: Add a 2x PNG export alongside editable SVG and CSV.
findings.verification: Actual downloaded PNG signature and 1600×916 pixel dimensions verified; all ten labels visually checked.

findings.finding: SVG title child arrays caused React warnings
findings.resolution: Use a single text value for each SVG title/description.
findings.verification: Server-rendered chart tests and browser console check.

findings.finding: Teaching samples could inherit unrelated analysis/pair settings
findings.resolution: Reset case/stop defaults for corpus examples and load parallel sample texts, tags and pairs together.
findings.verification: Browser sample workflow and exact mixed-corpus statistics.

findings.finding: Parallel input textareas lacked accessible names
findings.resolution: Add explicit Source segments and Target segments names.
findings.verification: Browser accessible-tree verification.

findings.finding: Very small positive TTR rounded to a misleading zero
findings.resolution: Use four significant digits in metrics and reports.
findings.verification: Regression: 1/400000 displays as 0.00025%.

findings.finding: Only a small core test suite existed
findings.resolution: Expand to 142 tests covering calculations, real file fixtures, storage, Unicode, figures, focus, saving races and maximum capacity.
findings.verification: npm test and production build; browser workflow matrix.

findings.finding: No automated research-quality gate for changes
findings.resolution: Run tests and the production build on pull requests and main.
findings.verification: GitHub Actions quality workflow; release run linked after merge.

findings.finding: The closed mobile sidebar remained keyboard/screen-reader accessible
findings.resolution: Hide the closed drawer from focus, add an explicit close control, trap focus in the open drawer, support Escape, restore focus, and close it when importing or moving to desktop.
findings.verification: 391px browser viewport: closed sidebar invisible, open drawer isolated from the workspace, Shift+Tab wraps, Escape closes; no page overflow.

findings.finding: HTML table cells could merge words; DOM parsing was not an isolated text-parser contract
findings.resolution: Use a lazy plain-AST HTML parser with table/block separators; scripts, embedded resources and structural boilerplate never become active browser content.
findings.verification: Offline HTML regression checks table boundaries, entities, excluded tags and multilingual text without DOM globals; real HTML file import.

findings.finding: Development hot reload could initialize a second React root
findings.resolution: Reuse the development root across hot module updates; production creates one root normally.
findings.verification: TypeScript and production build; final browser checks use the built static site rather than hot-reloaded sources.

limits: Word and sentence boundaries depend on the browser ICU implementation. These tests verify the fixtures and formulas, not a linguistic gold standard for every language or orthography. No automatic language detection, lemmatization, POS tagging, semantic alignment or translation-quality scoring is claimed.
Scanned PDFs require OCR elsewhere. PDF text order and embedded-font extraction depend on the source document. Imported saved HTML is cleaned text, not a remote website scraper.
Workspace limits remain 100 documents, 2,000,000 UTF-16 units of selected corpus text, 25 MB per file and 10,000 parallel pairs. Browser memory/storage limits still apply.

Concordance retains the first 1,000 hits and reports the full total. N-grams/collocates retain up to 500 rows; comparison retains up to 1,000. Figures display up to 30 rows and report the selected count. Sorting applies to retained results.

Library data is per origin/browser/device; explicit backup is necessary for portability. Unsaved text, pair edits and figure settings are session data. Parallel CSV/TMX exports preserve reviewed segments and notes.
CSV strings that could execute spreadsheet formulas are neutralized with an apostrophe. CSV values and JSON retain full numeric precision; on-screen numbers and plot labels are formatted.
G² and smoothed log-ratio comparisons are exploratory. Counts across different languages are not automatically semantically comparable; corpus design and human interpretation remain necessary.
Testing used the available Chromium browser and Node test runtime. Firefox, Safari, assistive technology and every mobile device have not been exhaustively certified.
